t: That section 460 of the Act of March 3, 1899 (30 Stat. 1336), as amended by the Acts of June 6, 1900 (31 Stat. 330), July 10, 1937 (50 Stat. 497), and May 31, 1938 (52 Stat. 587), is hereby repealed.

fable.w: This section simply repeals an earlier statutory provision and does nothing else. It creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking authority, outside consultation, or right to sue, so no party outside the federal government is brought into a federal decision. There is no real tempting reading here; the text contains no participation mechanism at all.

qwen_block.w: This section simply repeals a previous statute. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with outside parties. It is a legislative action affecting the legal code, not a procedural requirement for public input.
qwen_block.s: That section 460 of the Act of March 3, 1899 (30 Stat. 1336), as amended by the Acts of June 6, 1900 (31 Stat. 330), July 10, 1937 (50 Stat. 497), and May 31, 1938 (52 Stat. 587), is hereby repealed.

opus.b: 1. **Tempting reading:** The section cites several earlier Acts and amendments, which could make it look procedural. But it only repeals a provision. Nobody outside the federal government is consulted or given a role in any federal decision, so there is no participation.
